title: RallyWould Equine
specs: Located at The Grand Prix Equestrian Center of Austin with vintage charm and modern practicality
Staff on site 24/7 with horse-first mindset
Farrier and vet on site weekly, bodyworker monthly
Multiple arenas including covered arena under lights, large outdoor arena under lights, grass arena, and cross country field
Climate-controlled office, bathroom with shower, and lockable tack rooms
Owner must supply blankets or rent for $50/month if needed
Lessons for beginner riders include one-on-one instruction on horse handling, grooming, and tacking up
Riders expected to prepare horse independently once foundational skills are mastered
